text: This group, COM-04, contains 8 personal auto injury claims: 7 in the Low band and 1 in the Medium band. All 8 claims share the same clinic and attorney, Joseph Medical Clinic and Julie Kelly, which are the possible links that need human review. The highest-scoring claim is C-1311 (Medium, 10.4), so it should be reviewed first, followed by C-1012 (9.9) and then C-1003, C-1047, and C-1177, which all scored 9.5.
